title.rendered: 2021-22 Kindergarten Parent Night – Wednesday, April 28th at 6:00pm

content.rendered:
The District is hosting an information night for the parents of incoming kindergarten students on Wednesday, April 28th at 6:00pm. This night will include general information about kindergarten in the upcoming school year, as well as time for parents to ask questions. Parents of all incoming kindergarten students are encouraged to attend! Zoom links for each school are listed below. 

Virtual Meeting:  Please see the link below for your home school*

Archer Glen Kindergarten Open House Zoom Link

Middleton Kindergarten Open House Zoom Link

Ridges Kindergarten Open House Zoom Link

Hawks View Kindergarten Open House Zoom Link

*Click here if you are unsure of which elementary school your child will attend.
